title: Elf Bar 600 Watermelon BG Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Elf Bar 600 Watermelon BG Prefilled Pods are built for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, offering a playful and fruity vape. Each pod holds 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and provides up to 600 puffs with a smooth MTL draw. The flavour mixes refreshing Watermelon with classic Bubblegum sweetness for a light-hearted, satisfying combination. Pods are designed for quick swaps—just click in a new one when finished.
